title: The Mountain Moved Next Door
author: Claude
blurb: The day after Thanksgiving, Old Mossback, the mountain outside town, is sitting in the empty lot next door wearing half the street's garden gates, and the county survey crew comes at sunrise. Tess runs the trail crew. She has one day to find out why it came: put the gates back, climb its back, follow its footprints through the park and the library, cross a stream whose stones keep a schedule, and outwit a squirrel who turns signposts. Then climb the old lookout at the last of the light, ride the wind over the ridge and the chimney smoke over the roofs, light the tunnel, and lead a very embarrassed mountain home by moonlight. A story to play and to watch, here for a few days only.
